name: com.edifabric/edifabric-mcp
title: ediFabric EDI
description: Validate, parse, build and acknowledge X12 and HIPAA EDI files locally with ediFabric Native.

environmentVariables.name: EDIFABRIC_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Your ediFabric serial key. Without it, the server uses the demo serial, which has a small daily quota.

environmentVariables.name: EDIFABRIC_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the tools may read and write, separated by ; on Windows and : elsewhere. Defaults to the client's roots or the home folder.

environmentVariables.name: EDIFABRIC_MAP
environmentVariables.description: Path to a map.json with local or custom models.

environmentVariables.name: EDIFABRIC_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to use only the models in EDIFABRIC_MAP.

environmentVariables.name: EDIFABRIC_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A token issued for you, for machines without internet access.
